integrity: An elementary exact proof is included. Finite exact checks are supporting evidence only; independent scientific verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only K >= 2 with K congruent to 2 modulo 4; only moduli 2^r with r>=1.
No explicit orbit representatives or assertions for other recurrence coefficients.
Potential equivalent unindexed work cannot be ruled out by source search.
title: Complete orbit census for even-parameter Fibonacci recurrences modulo powers of two
